plan: Given my private value of $10, I should bid below this amount to ensure a potential profit if I win. Rational bidders will likely bid close to their value to maximize profit. To avoid overbidding and potential loss, I will bid slightly above the midpoint of $5 to $10, ensuring a chance to win if others bid low. This strategy balances the risk of overpaying with the possibility of winning.

Given my value of $30, I aim to maximize profit by winning the bid while paying less than my value. Assuming Andy and Charles are rational, they will bid close to their values but slightly lower to ensure profit. To outbid them, I should bid slightly above the average expected value, around $25. This balances winning probability and profit margin.

Given my value of $25, I aim to bid slightly below it to maximize profit if I win. Assuming rational behavior, Andy and Betty will also bid close to their values.
